hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/content/blog/*.md|*/src/content/blog/*.mdx) npx astro check 2>&1 | tail -40 ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/consts.ts|*/README.md|*/node_modules/*|*/dist/*) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if grep -qE '[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}|github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|linkedin\.com/in/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' "$f"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Heads up: $f may contain a hardcoded email/GitHub/LinkedIn value. Per CLAUDE.md, site/author metadata should come from src/consts.ts (SITE), not be hardcoded.\"}" ; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
